description: Confirmed permit-fee changes from /updates.json, newest first. Each row has the old figure, the new figure, the issuer, the source URL, and a citation. Figures are sourced and dated. They may be provisional. Cite the trail URL and the verifiedDate. Permit status is verified-official, reported-secondary, or unverified, or null when the feed has none. Null means not recorded. This server does not invent figures.

limit.description: How many changes to return. Default 20.

name: get_updates
title: Get updates
